ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.subTitle: From a simple idea to a powerful platform
ourStory.desc: Planora was founded at the Information Technology Institute (ITI) - Damanhour branch, where a group of passionate learners from the Front-End and Cross-Platform Development track came together with one goal - to turn knowledge into real impact. What started as a graduation project became a symbol of teamwork, creativity, and gratitude toward our mentors and colleagues. Planora reflects our hope for a lasting collaboration that continues beyond the classroom and grows into something meaningful
